title: Recursive majority complexity bound
statement: For each integer $d\geq 0$, define a function on $3^d$ signs recursively: at depth zero it returns the sole input, and at depth $d+1$ it takes the majority of the outputs obtained by applying the depth-$d$ function to each of three consecutive blocks of $3^d$ inputs. The randomized decision-tree complexity of this function, measured by the infimum of the worst-case expected number of queried coordinates among finite-seed, zero-error randomized decision trees, is at most $(8/3)^d$.
